prompt: The client wants to know which customer segment to prioritize for growth. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Small business has the most customers
options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: Enterprise brings in the most revenue
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: Enterprise brings $5M; mid-market brings $8M.

options.text: Enterprise customers are the hardest to serve
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

options.text: Mid-market is the biggest segment and adds the most revenue
options.feedback: Right. Revenue: small business $5M, mid-market $8M, enterprise $5M. At 20% growth, mid-market adds $1.6M a year.

explanation: Mid-market is the biggest segment and adds the most revenue. Revenue: small business $5M, mid-market $8M, enterprise $5M. At 20% growth, mid-market adds $1.6M a year.
